Evaluate a PubMed query: total hit count + which seed PMIDs are retrieved

Source: R/02_api_clients.R
pubmed_eval_query.Rd

Requests up to 2500 PMIDs in the initial `esearch` call so that queries with <= 2500 hits determine seed recall in a single HTTP request instead of two.

Usage

pubmed_eval_query(
  pm_query,
  seed_pmids,
  email = NULL,
  api_key = NULL,
  cache_dir = ".cache",
  use_cache = TRUE
)

Arguments

pm_query

PubMed query string.

seed_pmids

Character vector of seed PMIDs.

email

Optional email for NCBI tool identification.

api_key

Optional NCBI API key.

cache_dir

Directory for RDS cache.

use_cache

Logical; whether to read/write cache.

Value

List with `pm_hits`, `pm_found`, `pm_recall`, `ok`.
